notes.title: 🔥SpeedRun Challenge with a Prize! 🔑
notes.notes:
🔥Compete for the fastest time to win games! 🔑

Are you ready for a challenge? Do you think you have mastered Agent in Depth? Do you believe you can be the fastest and beat everyone else? Then join our challenge of getting the fastest time and win prizes! Put your reflexes and reaction time to the test as you race against the clock to complete the challenge as fast as possible.

[h3][b]The rules are simple: Beat Agent in Depth as fast as possible![/b][/h3]

Get the fastest time you can and post a link to the screenshot of your time by clicking the “Discuss” button below. The fastest one among the participants wins it all.

[b]Note:[/b] You can take a screenshot using Steam’s screenshot feature (Default F12). You can see the screenshot in the library page of the game. Click the share button on the top right of the image and choose the Public option under Visibility before uploading. You can then go to your profile and click the Screenshots button to find the image. Click the image and a link will appear on top of the image. Post that link as a comment under this post to participate.

[h3][b]What’s the prize?[/b][/h3]

The winner will get a Steam key for all released Next in Game titles. The prize includes 5 games:

[list]
[*] Guns & Fishes
[*] Non-Stop Raiders
[*] Planet TD
[*] Izmir: An Independence Simulator
[*] Soulflow
[/list]


Achieve the fastest time to prove you are the best ninja and win 5 games!

This award is limited to the first 3 user.

We are also discounting Agent in Depth 35% during the challenge. So, don’t be shy and tell your friends to also participate!

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - 21.01.2023
notes.notes:
[h1]What Changed?[/h1]

[h2]Summary[/h2]
Thank you for your interest in [b]Agent in Depth's[/b] amazing release date! I worked sooo hard this night to fix all reported bugs. I hope you're all having a good time playing the game. [b]See you in the leaderboard![/b] [i](I'm stading at #1 now, haha.)[/i]

[h3]Fixes![/h3]

[b]Fix: [/b] Font visibility problems in Asian languages are fixed. If you find errors, just hit me on Discussions page. 

[b]Fix:[/b] Level transition bug caused from stading between level enterences are now fixed. So, no more funny business messing up with Leaderboard! (I. SEE. YOU.)

[b]Fix:[/b] "Hell is Here" achievement is not triggering problem solved.

Hello everyone, it's Yigit from Naturepixel Studios! I want to announce that [b]Agent in Depth[/b] is now alive. It was a long and tiring run, but it's great to see you all experience (suffer) it ;)

[h2]What The F*** Is Agent in Depth?[/h2]
                             
"Agent in Depth is a [b]daring[/b] action-platformer featuring [b]fast-paced[/b] action and [b]instant-death[/b] combat. You’ll run, jump, aim, and [b]deflect bullets[/b] with your katana to blow up your enemies. [b]No checkpoints, no upgrades:[/b] just pure skills. Deflect, die, learn, repeat. Be better, be faster."

notes.title: 🔥🐱‍👤 The Last Ninja 🐱‍👤🔥 - Demo Live!
notes.notes:
Welcome to our first-ever blog post! We are excited to show our players our first-ever video game.
                             
Agent in Depth is a stylish pixel graphics indie action game featuring fast-paced action and instant-death combat. Unfold the truth by running, jumping, and deflecting bullets.
Get a refreshing experience with Agent in Depth’s unconventional combat and overcome your enemies using their bullets. Deflect oncoming attacks and leave no survivors
Each level is uniquely designed for you to experience a different sequence of gameplay every time you try to beat your previous time.

Security specialist: The turrets placed to protect you have started to attack their creators! You are the security specialist of this mega Corp; your sword can’t damage the corporation's belongings directly. Deflect gunfire and protect yourself. Can you unfold the truth between rouge turrets?
Fight Corp forces and look cool doing it: Dodge the oncoming bullets like a butterfly, sting them with their bullets like a bee, and look cool doing it!

Thank you all for reading our first-ever blog. We would love to see all of you on Steam Next Fest.
Don’t forget to add to your wishlist and join our discord server for more updates.
